newsitem.title: USA: Leahy probably back as US Senate ag panel leader.
newsitem.headline: Leahy probably back as US Senate ag panel leader.

text.p: Vermont Senator Pat Leahy, Democratic leader on the U.S. Senate Agriculture Committee, refused to engage in "speculation" that he would switch to another committee, a spokesman said Friday.
"That is only speculation," spokesman David Carle said, referring to talk that Leahy would leave the committee.

Before this week's elections, Capitol Hill sources painted scenarios in which Leahy would get the top slot on the Judiciary Committee. Democrats lost ground in the elections, reducing chances for any major shift in committee assignments.
